content.comment_body: Hello, sorry for replying after quite some time, but I am experiencing the same problem. In my application, the [product_name] also randomly inverts the output state after a while. Does anyone have a solution for this issue? In my setup, I configure the time using an NTC client and a government time server address. I also noticed that the output state changes after I adjust settings in online mode. For instance, when I alter settings in block properties and then update them online, the output inverts state. Best regards, [user_name]

I have not personally encountered this behavior. Please specify exactly which [product_name] you have, including the complete [article_no] and firmware [version_no]. A firmware update could potentially resolve the issue.
I resolved my problem. When configuring the properties of the astro clock, I mistakenly entered the longitude in the latitude field and vice versa. That was my error. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user described an issue with a [product_name] device inverting output states unexpectedly, especially after making online configuration changes. Eventually, the cause was identified as incorrect parameter entry in the astro clock settings, specifically swapping latitude and longitude values. This discussion highlights the significance of entering configuration data accurately, as mistakes can produce device behavior that appears to be technical faults.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] device to consistently manage output states based on programmed logic and time, not to invert outputs unexpectedly due to parameter configuration or changes in online settings.
